summary: UBOS Phase 4 Sub-pass A verified end-to-end (backend + frontend). 28/28 backend tests pass in test_ubos_phase4a.py covering share CRUD, public payload sensitive stripping (both top-level & legacy config.sensitive), visible_fields semantics (None=all, []=title-only, list=intersection), visibility gates (private/org_only 401, public 200), try_auth non-raising on bad Bearer, expired->410 with code:share_expired_or_revoked, unknown token 404, QR/barcode PNGs (authed + public), labels presets + PDF (>10KB, %PDF header, copies_per_record honored, invalid preset 422), view-scoped labels (X-Records-Included header), rate limiter (429 after burst, per-IP+XFF buckets), relationship summaries (no field leakage), sensitive field flag persistence + patch. Frontend: /s/:token public page renders correctly with QR + Code128 + workspace name + details table + read-only footer, all data-testids present. Share & Print right rail on RecordDetailPage shows inline QR & Code128 previews, New public link dialog + Print labels dialog work, share row testids match spec. FieldsPage Add-field modal exposes Sensitive toggle and the sensitive badge renders on existing fields. BulkToolbar shows Print labels button between Edit field & Delete, opens PrintLabelsDialog. Fixed one critical backend bug (labels view endpoint 500).

minor.issue: ViewLabelsBody.limit had default=500,le=500 but internal RecordSearchBody caps at le=200 → 500 Internal Server Error whenever caller didn't pass explicit limit. Fixed by lowering default/upper bound to 200.

rca of the issue:
Bug: POST /api/entity-types/{et_id}/records/labels returned 500 whenever the caller omitted `limit`.
Root cause: ViewLabelsBody defined `limit: int = Field(default=500, ge=1, le=500)`. The handler passes that value directly into RecordSearchBody(limit=body.limit), and RecordSearchBody caps `limit` at le=200. Pydantic then raised ValidationError → FastAPI surfaced as 500.
Repro: curl -X POST .../api/entity-types/{et_id}/records/labels -H 'Authorization: Bearer …' -d '{"config":{"preset":"avery_5160"}}' → 500.
Fix: lowered ViewLabelsBody default+ceiling to 200 to match RecordSearchBody. File /app/backend/routes/labels.py line ~48.
